### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **29** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**37** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `current_user (literal, 37 pages)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **149** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `19fb3477970d361f173e746076da7e1191e77fb1` — the merge of head `07f1f087aabd8c394f99dc1b7197bcc167bab2ee` into base `0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 19fb3477970d361f173e746076da7e1191e77fb1 && git checkout 19fb3477970d361f173e746076da7e1191e77fb1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01 07f1f087aabd8c394f99dc1b7197bcc167bab2ee && git checkout -B drift-repro 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01 && git merge --no-ff 07f1f087aabd8c394f99dc1b7197bcc167bab2ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0a6948210cc96a95cc568b30193895e157968c01` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `07f1f087aabd8c394f99dc1b7197bcc167bab2ee`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md + packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-relation.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, packages/spec/src/data/index.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts, packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.test.ts, .changeset/25760-controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.md, the three new test files (spec, plugin-security, lint). The rest of the diff (generated reference docs, strictness and liveness ledgers, api/authorable/export-origins surfaces, the four translation bundles and their two count pins, the metadata-protocol property-count pin, the two compose-stacks pins, the lint posture meta-guard) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT, read as a standalone PR of those files.

Inputs: card #25760 (body and all seven comments, ruling 6398566164 letter 1, the premise check 6409904490, the amended claim 6410093517, os-dev-reports 6411992806 / 6414737027 / 6417667323), PR #26005 (body, 35-file list, net diff against main), and the 48 check-runs on the head: every non-skipped run is `success` (Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Build Core, Type Check workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, Lint & Repo Gates and every scoped lane, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, the claim and single-writer guards); Lint UI, Test UI, Dogfood and Temporal lanes skipped by path filter. Judged against the AMENDED claim text.

### ① Derived judgments

Each accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, with its verdict.

1. **`ObjectSchema` accepts a new optional top-level key `sharing`, a `strictObject` carrying one `strictObject` `controlledByParent` with one `ownerMayEdit: boolean`** (object.zod.ts). RIGHT. Both blocks closed from the first release, `guidance` entries for the three near-miss spellings (`sharingModel`, `publicSharing`, a `ownerMayEdit` one level up); the spec test pins `unrecognized_keys` at `sharing` and at `sharing.controlledByParent`, and `invalid_type` for a string. A pure widening: no existing key moves, no existing value is refused.
2. **The parse refuses `ownerMayEdit: true` on an object whose `sharingModel` is not `controlled_by_parent`** (`refuseControlledByParentOwnerMayEditOffDetail`, called from the same `superRefine` as `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster`; one `custom` issue at `sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit`, naming the model or `no sharingModel`, with the prescription). RIGHT. A refusal on a key that did not exist before narrows nothing an author could write on main; it is the ADR-0049 shape (no door reads the key off a detail). `ownerMayEdit: false`, an empty `controlledByParent` and an empty `sharing` are accepted on any object and read as off; harmless.
3. **New export `controlledByParentOwnerMayEdit(schema: unknown): boolean` from `@objectstack/spec/data`** (`export * from './object.zod'` in data/index.ts; api-surface and export-origins moved by exactly that one symbol). RIGHT. Fail-closed on every unreadable shape (`=== true` only), does not read `sharingModel` (the caller's question), and is the ONE reader the parse, the gate (through `resolveCbpRelation`) and the lint share.
4. **`objectForm` gains a `sharing` composite beside `sharingModel`, nested `controlledByParent` composite, `ownerMayEdit` boolean leaf** (object.form.ts). RIGHT. Same nested-composite shape the file already uses; authorable-surface gained `data/Object:sharing`; the four translation bundles carry the six leaves and the two count pins moved with them (CI-forced, lane seat's). One wording nit, not a defect: the `controlledByParent` helpText says the block is refused on any other sharing model, while the parse refuses only `ownerMayEdit: true` there (an empty block is accepted). The leaf's own helpText and the Zod `describe` state the rule exactly.
5. **`CbpRelation.ownerMayEdit`** (security-plugin.ts, resolved in `resolveCbpRelation`): true only when the relation resolves AND the schema reader answers true AND the registered field map carries `owner_id`. RIGHT. Resolved on the same schema the relation came from; an opt-in without the owner column resolves `false` and is reported once per `cbpRelCache` generation at `warn` (`reportOwnerMayEditWithoutOwnerColumn`, host method and relation-module body, the `reportCbpMasterUnresolved` pattern). The plugin-security rig pins `omd_note` (`ownership: 'none'`) refused by the master gate and reported exactly once across two writes.
6. **The owner leg in `assertControlledByParentWrite`** (cbp-write-gate.ts), placed after the `masterId == null` branch and before the §3 chain walk, admitting the write when ALL hold: `operation === 'update'`; `detailRow !== null` (set only in the single-id branch, after `extractSingleId`; the predicate `multi: true` path and the insert path leave it `null` and the predicate path returns before the leg); `rel.ownerMayEdit`; `!opCtx.context.onBehalfOf.userId` (the same envelope the master-floor exclusion reads, shared by both passes of a delegated write, so the delegator's pass with its own `context` cannot slip through); `context.userId` equals the stored row's `owner_id` (read as system above, so the caller cannot supply it); and `readUnlessRefused` around `this.readRowById(rel.master, masterId, context)` returns a row. RIGHT. `readRowById` is `ql.findOne(master, { where: { id }, context })` under the caller's own context, i.e. the engine's read door with this plugin's read derivation and the sharing middleware, so the probe is the answer a direct read of the master gives; a declared 4xx and a hidden row are one answer (`refused` / `null`, #7505 semantics in `readUnlessRefused`), a store fault propagates. On admission the leg still runs `askBodyNamedMaster([masterId])`, so a body that re-points the master asks EDIT on the master it names and a body naming the stored master is not asked again; `masterNotWritable` (#25095) and the null-master freeze (#8688 / #9137) are judged before the leg, unchanged. Every other shape (insert, delete, predicate update, delegated write, non-owner, unowned row, unreadable master, no opt-in) falls through to the §3 walk and carries the walk's own envelope, so no new sentence reaches a response body. The 17-pin rig over the real SecurityPlugin + ObjectQL + SqlDriver + SharingService pins each of those boundaries plus two admitted controls (master editor who owns nothing; owner on an opted-in detail), and the dev's ablation reported 4 red / 13 green, the expected split.
7. **`ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` and `security/explain` follow the leg** — the served member builds `opCtx = { object, operation: 'update', options: { where: { id } }, context }` and runs the same `assertControlledByParentWrite` on both principals; `explain-engine.ts` consults it for by-id writes. RIGHT; the rig pins `allow` for the owner and `deny` for the same grants without ownership and for the non-opted detail.
8. **Lint: new advisory arm `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` (`warning`), its constant exported from the barrel, its `os explain` entry** (validate-security-posture.ts, rule-explanations.ts, index.ts). RIGHT. Subject: an enabled `update` / `all` row-level policy naming a `controlled_by_parent` object of the stack whose master resolves (`owdOf` + the lint's own `resolveCbpRelation`) and whose `controlledByParentOwnerMayEdit` is false; judged on `using` and `check` separately by shape on the canonical CEL AST (`parseCelToAst(sqlPredicateToCel(...))`, both in `@objectstack/formula`, already a declared dependency of `@objectstack/lint`): `FIELD == current_user.id` either order, bare or `record.FIELD`, under `&&` / `||`; a non-parsing predicate keys on nothing (the parse rule's). `warning` is the right tier: `authoring-rules.ts` splits findings into `errors` (refuse) and `advisories`, so the runtime publish doors do not refuse the shape, and a narrowing can be meant. The #5017 receiver meta-guard, the push-site count 17 to 18 and the reachability corpus fixture moved with it.
9. **ADR-0055 amended in place** (status line, the §3 rule line marked, a closing Amendment section). RIGHT and faithful to the diff: it records letter 1, option 2 not chosen, the four gate conditions, the three things the leg does not change, the out-of-scope verbs with their reasons, the fail-closed boundaries (owner-column half reported at resolution because `injected-system-columns.ts` imports `object.zod.ts`, verified), and what stands. Every symbol it cites resolves (`assertControlledByParentWrite`, `resolveCbpRelation`, `masterGateCoversOperation`, `reportOwnerMayEditWithoutOwnerColumn`, the §2 "all AND-ed" line, ADR-0139 D6, ADR-0090 D10). Governed surface, Tier H: this record does not merge it; a GOVERNED_APPROVER's word does.
10. **Metadata-core `OBJECT_REFERENCE_POSITIONS.sharing: keep`** and the `/meta/types` object property count 47 to 48: RIGHT, both forced by the new key, both what the key is (a block of booleans naming no field).
11. **Scope matches the ruling.** The ruling names `update`; the diff admits a by-id update only and states insert, delete, predicate update and delegated writes stay on master EDIT, with none foreclosed. The card's "Not asked" items hold: the default is unchanged (the `omd_task` pins), and `os lint` keeps flagging the dead owner policy.

Nothing in the diff widens beyond the ruling, and nothing narrows an existing accept set.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening)

- Changeset `.changeset/25760-controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/lint` all `minor`, carrying `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added (...)` and `Ruling-ref: 6398566164 (letter 1)` as line-initial declarations identical to the PR body's. RIGHT: a new authorable key is `added`, and `added` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves (spec moves); `yes (widening)` is the correct arm for a gate that admits more callers and refuses nothing it admitted before; no `(narrowing)` arm, no BREAKING banner owed, no ADR-0087 disposition owed, no `skip-changeset`.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` also move published source (one `keep` classification row; regenerated translation bundles) and are not listed. Not a defect: every publishable package sits in the one `fixed` group, so the `minor` bump reaches them in lockstep, and the level axis of `check-changeset-no-major` asks for at least one moved package graded `minor` or above (Check Changeset: success). `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` move test files only.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's current os-dev-report is 6417667323; `open_questions: []`. Every deviation and out-of-scope finding, answered:

1. **Claim surface widened by CI reds** (metadata-core classification; the four translation bundles with six hand-translated leaves and two count pins; the metadata-protocol served-schema pin). ANSWERED: each is a gate-forced consequence of the new key, each is in the amended claim 6410093517, each matches the diff, none is a design widening.
2. **BREACH: `packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.test.ts`, an explicit 30 s timeout on the BOUNDARY test, seat ruling A.** ANSWERED, accepted. The hunk adds a five-line comment naming the measurement and the `30_000` argument; no assertion, no skip, no quarantine, no core source moves in this diff, so the PR cannot be the cause of the enumeration's cost (about 133k paths times 6 methods, 1.3 s idle, 5.4 s on the loaded shard across three runs). Test Core (5/8) is `success` on this head. The dev's out-of-scope note that a cheaper enumeration is core's owner's call is the right carrier for the follow-up; nothing to escalate.
3. **The shard-5 failure could not be named from the earlier runs** (log tail cap, blob host denied). ANSWERED: process, not product; the head's check-runs are the verdict and are green.
4. **The head's gate sweep ran in two runners; the first-round runner ran unlocked.** ANSWERED: local runs are not this record's input; the derived families are answered by Lint & Repo Gates, the Type Check and Test Core lanes, all `success`.
5. **One single-file vitest run outside the lock.** ANSWERED: same as 4.
6. Out-of-scope findings: (a) `content/docs/permissions/*.mdx` do not yet mention the opt-in while the generated reference pages do, noted not filed: ACCEPTED as docs follow-up, no gate owes it. (b) The owner-column half of the opt-in is reported at runtime rather than refused at parse, because of the `injected-system-columns.ts` to `object.zod.ts` import cycle: ACCEPTED, the boundary is fail-closed (the opt-in resolves to `false`, the §3 rule holds, one `warn` per object), the ADR amendment and the gate docblock both state it, and the rig pins it. (c) auth-gate enumeration cost, (d) teardown-shape self-test on a shallow clone, (e) job-log tail cap, (f) reaped background process: seat and tooling notes, nothing for this record to escalate.

No flag is left open. The PR stays a draft awaiting the Tier H approval the ADR amendment owes; this record is the contract-tier review of record for the head above and merges nothing.

## 维护者速读

### 改了什么

这个 PR 给"访问随主记录"（`controlled_by_parent`）的从对象加了一个按对象声明的开关：`sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit: true`。打开后，从记录的所有者（`owner_id` 是本人）只要能读主记录，就能按 id 修改自己这条从记录。其他人照旧要求对主记录有编辑权，新增、删除、按条件批量改、代办写入也都照旧。不开这个开关，行为与现在完全一样。

`os lint` 新增一条 warning：从对象没开开关、却写了 `owner_id == current_user.id` 的更新策略时，提示作者这条策略放不进所有者。ADR-0055 §3 已同步修订。

### 为什么改

依据裁决 6398566164 第 1 条。这对应 Salesforce 里"活动随父记录控制，但所有者能改自己的活动"的形态：销售能看客户、不能改客户，但要能改自己名下挂在客户上的任务。原来平台表达不了这一点；作者自己写行级策略也无效，因为行级策略只会收窄，不会放宽主记录门。

### 风险与代价（含回滚）

- 只有三件事同时成立才放宽：对象显式声明了开关，调用者是该行的 `owner_id`，调用者能读主记录。默认值不变，存量对象不受影响。
- 边界都有测试钉住：非所有者、无所有者的行、读不到主记录的所有者、新增、删除、批量改、代办写、把行挪到另一条主记录下，全部仍被主记录门拒绝。
- 主记录的读探针以调用者自己的身份走引擎读门，不是系统级读，所以结论与调用者直接读主记录一致。这一处校正了草稿里"`sys_` 级读探针"的写法。
- 回滚：删掉对象上这一个键即恢复原行为。代码层面，它是写门里一个独立分支，去掉即回到 §3 原规则。

### 席位意见

建议批准。契约审查 PASS（6417851199），席位核对见下方。这是纯放宽：没有任何现有写法被收窄，新键从第一版起就是封闭结构，CI 48 项 0 失败。

只有一个不阻塞的小瑕疵：表单上 `controlledByParent` 的帮助文字说"其他共享模型下整块被拒"，实际只拒 `ownerMayEdit: true`。留待之后顺手修，不在本 PR 改。

### 你要做的

审阅 `docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` 的修订段落，同意就在本 PR 点 Approve。之后由席位落地。
